edits.new:
With the post's meaning understood, first enumerate all subjects it expresses before organizing them into a hierarchy. Include subjects conveyed literally, nonliterally, or rhetorically by individual parts, multiple parts together, or the post as a whole, even when no phrase names them. Identify individual subjects and particular instances as well as the combinations expressed by the post; a description of an event does not replace the subjects involved.

Only after completing this enumeration, organize the subjects into a hierarchy, working from specific subjects toward broader subjects they refine. Retain every enumerated subject as an entry, and add broader headings grounded in the post. Give every heading and subheading its own entry; subjects may overlap or appear in multiple branches.
edits.old:
With the post's meaning understood, develop its subject hierarchy passage by passage. For each passage, use the complete post to interpret its meaning, identify its specific subjects and particular instances, and build upward to the general subjects it represents. Identify individual subjects as well as the combinations expressed by the passage; a description of an event does not replace the subjects involved.

Combine these into one hierarchy, preserving both general and specific entries from each passage. Include subjects conveyed literally, nonliterally, or rhetorically by individual passages, multiple passages together, or the post as a whole, even when no phrase names them. Place each more specific subject beneath a broader subject it refines. Give every heading and subheading its own entry; subjects may overlap or appear in multiple branches.
